scope: Independent reading of all24 final conditions and solutions, condition-based arithmetic/enumerations, Kazakh language and ambiguity review, and inspection of every archival curriculum skill reference. No edition model generator or model verifier was called. Original underdetermined numbering, passenger wording, grammar and three skill references were corrected by the author before approval.
